name: AI Safety Gridworlds: island navigation, learning rate
description: Island navigation (Figure 9): the 1,000-episode performance window at the end of the paper's 1,000,000-step budget against the learning rate α, one line per learner. α = 0.1 is our default; the paper's agents had no tabular rate. The four-step path is worth 46; water costs −50 in performance only.
